# 1 Chronicles Chapter 22 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 381v–382r

---

**22:1** And-said David: This [is] the-house of-YHWH the-Elohim, and-this [is] the-altar of-burnt-offering [mizbach ha-olah] for-Yisra'el.

**22:2** And-said David to-gather the-sojourners [ha-gerim] who [were] in-the-land of-Yisra'el, and-he-appointed stone-cutters [chotsvey] to-cut dressed-stones [avney gazit] to-build the-house of-Elohim.

**22:3** And-iron [barzel] in-abundance [larov] for-the-nails [le-masmerim] for-the-doors [daltot] of-the-gates [ha-she'arim] and-for-the-joints [le-mechabberot] David prepared [hekhin], and-bronze [nechoshet] in-abundance without-weighing [le-eyn mishqal].

**22:4** And-wood of-cedars [atsey arazim] without number [le-eyn mispar], for the-Tsidonim and-the-Tsorim brought cedar-wood [atsey arazim] in-abundance to-David.

**22:5** And-said David: Shelomoh my-son [is] young [na'ar] and-tender [varakh], and-the-house to-be-built for-YHWH [must be] exceedingly-great [le-magdelah le-ma'elah], for-a-name [leshem] and-for-splendor [letif'eret] for-all the-lands [kol ha-aratsot]. Let-me-prepare [akhinah] now for-it. And-prepared David in-abundance before his-death.

**22:6** And-he-called for-Shelomoh his-son, and-commanded-him to-build a-house for-YHWH Elohey Yisra'el.

**22:7** And-said David to-Shelomoh: My-son, as-for-me, it-was with my-heart [levavi] to-build a-house for-the-name of-YHWH my-Elohim.

**22:8** And-the-word of-YHWH came upon-me, saying: Blood [dam] in-abundance [larov] you-have-shed [shafakhta], and-great wars [milchamot gedolot] you-have-made. You-shall-not build a-house for-my-name, for much blood [damim rabbim] you-have-shed to-the-ground [artsah] before-me.

**22:9** Behold, a-son is-born [nolad] to-you — he shall-be a-man of-rest [ish menuchah], and-I-will-give-him rest [vahaniychoti lo] from-all his-enemies from-all-around [mi-saviv]. For Shelomoh [shelomoh] shall-be his-name, and-peace [shalom] and-quietness [sheqet] I-will-give over Yisra'el in-his-days.

**22:10** He shall-build a-house for-my-name, and-he shall-be to-me as-a-son, and-I [will be] to-him as-a-father, and-I-will-establish the-throne of-his-kingdom over Yisra'el until eternity [ad olam].

**22:11** Now, my-son, may-YHWH be with-you, and-you-shall-prosper [vehitslachta] and-build the-house of-YHWH your-Elohim, as he-spoke concerning-you.

**22:12** Only [akh], may-YHWH give to-you insight [sekhel] and-understanding [tevunah], and-command-you [vitsavvekha] concerning Yisra'el, and-to-keep [velishmor] the-Torah of-YHWH your-Elohim.

**22:13** Then you-shall-prosper [tatsli'ach], if you-keep [tishmor] to-do the-statutes [ha-chuqqim] and-the-judgments [ha-mishpatim] that YHWH commanded Mosheh concerning Yisra'el. Be-strong [chazaq] and-be-courageous [ve'emats]. Do-not fear [al tira] and-do-not be-dismayed [al techat].

**22:14** And-behold, in-my-affliction [be-onyi] I-have-prepared for-the-house of-YHWH gold [zahav], a-hundred thousand talents [kikkar], and-silver a-thousand thousand talents [elef elef kikkar], and-bronze and-iron without-weighing [le-eyn mishqal], for it-is in-abundance [larov]. And-wood and-stones I-have-prepared, and-upon-[these] you-shall-add.

**22:15** And-with-you [are] workers [osey melakhah] in-abundance — hewers [chotsvim] and-workers [charashey] of-stone and-wood, and-every skilled-one [kol chakhom] in-every work [melakhah].

**22:16** For-the-gold, for-the-silver, and-for-the-bronze, and-for-the-iron — there-is-no number [eyn mispar]. Arise [qum] and-do [va'aseh], and-may-YHWH be with-you.

**22:17** And-commanded David all the-princes [sarey] of-Yisra'el to-help Shelomoh his-son:

**22:18** Is-not YHWH your-Elohim with-you? And-has-he-not given-you rest [heniach] from-all-around [mi-saviv]? For he-gave in-my-hand the-inhabitants [yoshevey] of-the-land, and-the-land is-subdued [nikhbeshah] before YHWH and-before his-people.

**22:19** Now set [tenu] your-heart [levavkhem] and-your-soul [nafshekhem] to-seek [lidrosh] YHWH your-Elohim. And-arise [qumu] and-build the-sanctuary [miqdash] of-YHWH the-Elohim, to-bring the-ark of-the-covenant of-YHWH and-the-holy [qodesh] vessels of-Elohim to-the-house that-shall-be-built for-the-name of-YHWH.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "This is the house of YHWH":** David declares the threshing floor to be the future temple site. This verse is the crucial link between the plague narrative (ch.21) and the temple preparations. The threshing floor of Ornan becomes the house of God.

**v.8 — "Blood in abundance you have shed":** This explanation for why David cannot build the temple is unique to Chronicles. In 2 Samuel 7 and 1 Chronicles 17, the reason given is different (God has not yet chosen to dwell in a house). The Chronicler adds this theological rationale: David's hands are stained with blood; the man of war cannot build the house of peace. The wordplay between Solomon (*shelomoh*) and peace (*shalom*) in v.9 reinforces this.

**v.9 — Man of rest / Solomon / peace:** A triple wordplay: *ish menuchah* (man of rest), *shelomoh* (Solomon, from *shalom*), and *shalom vasheket* (peace and quiet). Solomon's very name encodes his destiny.

**v.14 — "a hundred thousand talents of gold":** At roughly 75 pounds per talent, this equals approximately 3,750 tons of gold. The number is hyperbolic by any accounting — it exceeds all gold ever mined in the ancient world. The Chronicler uses astronomical figures to express the incalculable worth of the temple.

*— EMET*
